question: What is the colour of the sending off card in football?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Red**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sending off card in football is **red**.
 
• A red card is shown by the referee to signify that a player must be sent off the field and cannot be replaced.
